action.value: I was the harbour physician of Kalos, and I set a boy's broken arm by lamplight while the fleet burned.
action.label: Step 1: name and first memory

note: Name: Iolanthe Vess

action.value: Marek Vess — My younger brother, a rope-maker who never learned to swim.
action.label: Draft mortal Marek Vess

action.value: Sister Ilka — The nun who taught me letters and kept my father's debts quiet.
action.label: Draft mortal Sister Ilka

action.value: Captain Doru — Harbourmaster, and the only man who ever called me a liar to my face.
action.label: Draft mortal Captain Doru

note: Twenty years of setting bones and cutting fevers out of sailors.
I can tell from the smell of the water when a ship will not come back.
I learned to wait beside deathbeds without moving.
A stone chamber above the harbour where I kept my instruments.
Every debt in Kalos, written in a hand I can still forge.

action.label: Add resource A Case of Silver Knives

note: Sharp, cold, and the only thing I carried out of the city.
Needs 3 more memories, each tagged with at least 2 traits

action.value: The plague year: I kept the lamp room burning and let no one in, and Marek stood in the street calling my name until dawn.
action.label: Draft memory 2 tagged Marek Vess + Physician

note: Two traits are the minimum for a creation memory

action.value: I forged my father's ledger to buy Sister Ilka's silence, and she blessed me for it without knowing what she blessed.
action.label: Draft memory 3 tagged Sister Ilka + Reads the Tide

note: Two traits are the minimum for a creation memory

action.value: Captain Doru dragged me to the water's edge and made me name the ships that would not return; every one of them sank.
action.label: Draft memory 4 tagged Captain Doru + Patient

note: Two traits are the minimum for a creation memory
She came up the harbour steps dripping, and she has never once been dry since.
The floor is always damp where I have stood, whatever the weather.

action.value: The Salt Lady opened my throat with one of my own silver knives and held me under the harbour until the burning stopped.
action.label: Draft curse memory tagged Wet Footprints + The Lamp Room

note: Save & Play unlocks once the curse memory has text and 2 traits

action.label: Save & Play — enter play at prompt 1a

note: startPlay() gate passed: 5 memories, 3 skills, 3 resources, 3 mortals, 1 immortal, 1 mark
